author: Woogmoog
quote: Another the Sims series that is nothing but exploration to build your house after you get some money doing a few things here and there. For a game that is claimed to be so big to be released with the amount of bugs, with no option to lower graphics, for those who don’t care about extreme quality but want to play with a better fps compared to the price paid, I wouldn’t recommend to anyone at this state of the game. That 99 metacritic score is a bought for sure.
